name: migrationhubstrategy
description: Migration Hub Strategy Recommendations This API reference provides descriptions, syntax, and other details about each of the actions and data types for Migration Hub Strategy Recommendations (Strategy Recommendations).

subcommands.name: get-application-component-details
subcommands.description: Retrieves details about an application component.

subcommands.name: get-application-component-strategies
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of all the recommended strategies and tools for an application component running on a server.

subcommands.name: get-assessment
subcommands.description: Retrieves the status of an on-going assessment.

subcommands.name: get-import-file-task
subcommands.description: Retrieves the details about a specific import task.

subcommands.name: get-latest-assessment-id
subcommands.description: Retrieve the latest ID of a specific assessment task.

subcommands.name: get-portfolio-preferences
subcommands.description: Retrieves your migration and modernization preferences.

subcommands.name: get-portfolio-summary
subcommands.description: Retrieves overall summary including the number of servers to rehost and the overall number of anti-patterns.

subcommands.name: get-recommendation-report-details
subcommands.description: Retrieves detailed information about the specified recommendation report.

subcommands.name: get-server-details
subcommands.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specified server.

subcommands.name: get-server-strategies
subcommands.description: Retrieves recommended strategies and tools for the specified server.

subcommands.name: list-analyzable-servers
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of all the servers fetched from customer vCenter using Strategy Recommendation Collector.

subcommands.name: list-application-components
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of all the application components (processes).

subcommands.name: list-collectors
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of all the installed collectors.

subcommands.name: list-import-file-task
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of all the imports performed.

subcommands.name: list-servers
subcommands.description: Returns a list of all the servers.

subcommands.name: put-portfolio-preferences
subcommands.description: Saves the specified migration and modernization preferences.

subcommands.name: start-assessment
subcommands.description: Starts the assessment of an on-premises environment.

subcommands.name: start-import-file-task
subcommands.description: Starts a file import.

subcommands.name: start-recommendation-report-generation
subcommands.description: Starts generating a recommendation report.

subcommands.name: stop-assessment
subcommands.description: Stops the assessment of an on-premises environment.

subcommands.name: update-application-component-config
subcommands.description: Updates the configuration of an application component.

subcommands.name: update-server-config
subcommands.description: Updates the configuration of the specified server.
